Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a deep ebony-brown complexion, early 20s goddess, glamour hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — a stunning hourglass figure, far more dramatically curved than any ordinary woman; a full, rounded bust, a dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist with a deep shadowed groove running around her middle, and wide, curvaceous hips flaring well beyond her shoulders, soft rounded thighs, toned but soft arms; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, blunt bob natural black hair — her body is painted in 5 different painting styles at once, each style claiming its own region of her figure. Every style is rendered in one shared palette of deep indigo, ivory white and gold, so the whole figure reads as one harmonious composition. Her figure is divided into 5 concentric regions around a single centre point located at the middle of her bust, about 27% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure, separated by 4 hazy ring-shaped transition zones at about 14%, 34%, 58% and 80% of the way out from that centre point to the farthest edge of her figure. Region 1 is the innermost core around the centre point: it carries Kandinsky style circles, triangles and sweeping lines rendered only in deep indigo, ivory white and gold. Her bust carries a large smiley face on each breast, a round yellow smiley face with two oval black eyes and a wide curved smile, a thin black outline and a glossy highlight, the plain yellow centre of the face fully and opaquely covering her nipple and areola, the yellow spreading outward over the curve of her bust. Region 2 is the ring between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries Lichtenstein style Ben-Day dots and thick outlines rendered only in deep indigo, ivory white and gold. Region 3 is the ring between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries Hokusai Great Wave style rolling waves with foam claws and bold linework rendered only in deep indigo, ivory white and gold. Region 4 is the ring between transition zone 3 and transition zone 4: it carries high-gloss enamel colour blocks with wet-looking highlights rendered only in deep indigo, ivory white and gold. Region 5 is the outermost region beyond the last ring: it carries Matisse style paper cut-out leaf-like shapes rendered only in deep indigo, ivory white and gold. Where two regions meet, the two neighbouring paintings blend along the edge: brushwork of one reaches into the other and the two styles simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring paintings, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a perfectly circular course, every painting laid on her own living skin and covering her completely from neck to ankle. Her face and ears stay real living skin with visible pores, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a soft natural flush. Pose: strong hip pop right, both hands pressing sides of hips outward simultaneously arching back to extreme, her legs fully in view — most extreme glamour hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals made of glossy cobalt blue leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.

Jewelry: a pair of large hoop earrings of polished gold with blackened iron accents as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: clearly visible, bold and well defined: bold white eyeshadow across the lids, white glossy lips, a bright turquoise liner accent at the outer corners, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows light natural skin glow, subtle healthy sheen.

Background: a bright spring garden terrace of pale stone with blooming tulip beds, a low trimmed hedge, a standard-height garden gate and a bench, just after the rain, with wet surfaces shining softly, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor.
